t: The Milwaukee 14-in-1 Shockwave Interchangeable Multi-Bit Screwdriver is a versatile fastening tool designed for trade professionals. It features an ergonomic soft-grip handle for comfortable, efficient use during prolonged tasks, making it ideal for electricians and plumbers. Convenient in-handle bit storage keeps accessories organised and easily accessible. Features a removable SHOCKWAVE magnetic bit holder with a 6mm (1/4") hex shank, making it power-tool-ready for maximum jobsite versatility. Durable bi-metal blades provide long-lasting performance, and laser-engraved sizing on the double-sided bits allows for fast, easy identification to streamline workflow and improve efficiency. Supplied with Hex 3mm, 4mm, 5mm, PH1, PH2, PZ1, PZ2, T10, T15, T20, T25, Slotted 0.8 x 5.5mm and 1.2 x 6.5mm bits.
b: Provides In-Handle Bit Storage & Quick Access
Removable Bit Holder to Access Tight Spaces
Laser-Engraved Sizing for Fast Bit Identification
